value.text: 1–2 min modern/jazz/contemporary phrase: level changes, torso articulation, breath, isolations.
Ballet: dégagés/jetés, pas de bourrée, pirouettes; petit allegro; grand allegro if space allows.
Self- or other-choreographed solo, 1–2 min, genre of choice — a different style than the phrase is encouraged (shows versatility).
